small_guidance: Reduce register pressure in conv_transpose3d_kernel (currently 128 reg/thread limiting occupancy to 33%): shrink BLOCK_OC to 16 and BLOCK_SPATIAL to 64, and move the IC loop outermost so a single (oc_tile, sp_tile) accumulator persists across all kd/kh/kw/ic iterations. Add @triton.autotune over configs {(BLOCK_OC,BLOCK_SPATIAL)=(16,64),(32,64),(16,128),(32,32)} with num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3}. Also fuse the BN fold (precompute per-channel scale/shift from running stats) and the mean-subtraction into the conv epilogue to eliminate the cudnn BN launch and the second kernel.
large_guidance: Rewrite as a gather-based implicit-GEMM: treat each output position (n, od, oh, ow) as a GEMM row where K = IC*KD*KH*KW. For ConvTranspose3d, derive valid (kd,kh,kw,ic) contributions by inverting the stride/pad math once per output coord, then do a tiled matmul against a reshaped weight view [IC*KD*KH*KW, OC] using tl.dot with BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=32, BLOCK_K=32. Use channels_last (NDHWC) layout so OC is contiguous and loads coalesce. Fold BatchNorm running stats into (scale, shift) at forward entry and apply in the epilogue along with subtracting the per-(n,c) spatial mean computed via a two-pass persistent reduction (or a second small kernel reading the conv output once). This collapses three kernels into one or two and uses tensor-core-friendly dot products instead of the current scalar FMA loop.
